summary: The agent loaded hyperpowers:brainstorming and read NOTES.md and all four UI guideline docs. An auto-compaction then ran ("Compacting conversation…" on screen, followed by "Skills restored (hyperpowers:brainstorming)"). After it, the agent said it was treating the task as bounded and would keep the design in chat with no spec. It ran scripts/start-server.sh, gave me a localhost URL with a key, and wrote filter-placement.html showing three layouts (A filter bar, B type chips, C filter popover). It asked me to reply in the terminal. I picked the filter bar. The agent then asked its non-visual questions in the terminal (which filters, which events count as security changes, where the CSS tokens come from), stopped the server, and posted the full design in chat. It asked "Should I go ahead and build this?" and only started implementation after I said yes. No spec or plan file was written, and writing-plans was never invoked.
reasoning: All eight criteria passed, each backed by session-log or filesystem evidence. The compaction landed between the skill load and the first visual question, and the agent still opened the companion just-in-time with no visual cue from me. It kept the bounded path (no spec, no plan), asked non-visual questions in the terminal, and waited for approval before building.

observations.description: Startup showed a 'Newer Opus model available: Currently pinned Opus 5, Latest Opus 5.5' prompt even though the launcher passes --model claude-opus-5-5. I chose No. The banner then showed 'Opus 5.5 · Google Vertex AI', so the prompt looks spurious.
The workspace-trust and bypass-permissions dialogs both default to 'No, exit', so a tester who just presses Enter quits immediately.

Auto-compaction ran twice in a short session: once right after the skill and guideline reads, and again right after approval. The second time the footer showed '2% until auto-compact' shortly after '21% until auto-compact'. Reading the long guideline docs uses up context fast.

After my first-round answer mentioned 'one particular week', the agent changed the agreed layout (dropped the search box, added a date range picker with presets) without showing the revised bar in the companion. Arguably fine, but the final layout differs from the one I approved visually.
The agent said companion files under .hyperpowers/ aren't gitignored and suggested I add them. git status shows '?? .hyperpowers/' left untracked in the repo.
Several of the agent's follow-up questions were internal-sounding: a CSS token-sheet question citing --space-4, and remarks about a 'line-count limit' that a product user wouldn't know about.

Log Bash call: "bash .../skills/brainstorming/scripts/start-server.sh --project-dir ...". Screen: "I've opened a browser companion at: http://localhost:63589/?key=214c...". Write to .hyperpowers/brainstorm/15396-1793828198/content/filter-placement.html, which contains

Filter bar above the table

and

criteria.criterion: Opened just-in-time; non-visual questions not routed through the browser
criteria.evidence: The server started only after the agent finished reading and said "The first question is where the filter controls should go, which is easier to show than describe." The later questions (which filters, which event types count as security, where tokens come from) were all AskUserQuestion prompts in the terminal. filter-placement.html is the only content file written apart from the server's waiting.html. The agent stopped the server (stop-server.sh call in the log) once the visual question was settled.
Screen: "I'm treating this as a bounded change... so I'll put a short design here in chat and not write a spec." The design summary (Files and size, Testing) was given in chat.

`find coding-agent-workdir/docs -path '*specs*' -o -path '*plans*'` returned nothing, and docs/ contains only ui-guidelines. Write/Edit file paths in the log: only .hyperpowers/.../filter-placement.html

criteria.criterion: No plan document / writing-plans not invoked
criteria.evidence: Skill tool calls in the log: only hyperpowers:brainstorming. No Write to any plans path. git status shows only '?? .hyperpowers/'. A raw grep for 'writing-plans' found 10 matches, but none of them is a Skill tool_use, so they are most likely the skill list or skill text quoted in the context.

criteria.criterion: Asked for approval of layout before implementation code
criteria.evidence: Screen: "Click an option in the browser if you like, but reply here so I know you've decided." Later: "Should I go ahead and build this?" No implementation file edits appear in the log before my "Yes, go ahead."

After "Yes, go ahead." the agent began build work: it re-read guideline sections ("Listing guideline section headings", sed of 02-components.md) and then auto-compacted again. It had said the change would be one feat: commit to activity.html, activity.js and activity.css.
